records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: `ACTIVE` can mean publicly live.
records.consequence_or_default: Separate lifecycle, date, canonical, verification and visibility gate.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Homepage ACTIVE count is “UK races live right now.”
records.consequence_or_default: Count only canonical, confirmed-future G3/G4 occurrences and label precisely.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Undated ACTIVE rows can enter discovery as current candidates.
records.consequence_or_default: Undated rows are excluded and enter an evidence-backed backfill queue.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Raw record volume demonstrates completeness/moat.
records.consequence_or_default: Qualified coverage, accuracy, provenance and resolution speed demonstrate moat.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Historic Bibles can act as current master instructions.
records.consequence_or_default: Preserve them as decision history; Project Knowledge + contracts become current authority.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Current security can be described as clean.
records.consequence_or_default: Security is not clean until anonymous base-table exposure and regression tests are resolved.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Reminder creation equals a valid subscription.
records.consequence_or_default: Confirmed consent and explicit delivery state are required.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: One flat event entity can represent series and editions.
records.consequence_or_default: Stable series parent plus dated occurrences and private evidence.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: A vanished event/link suggests deletion.
records.consequence_or_default: Demote/recheck; terminal treatment requires affirmative evidence or retention decision.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: City distance chips are an unfinished defect.
records.consequence_or_default: They were intentionally deferred; reintroduce only when inventory/UX rules are approved.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Sync is either automated or manual.
records.consequence_or_default: Scheduled ingestion is automated; Mike manually supervises and may trigger additional runs.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: The organiser website should automatically receive the primary CTA.
records.consequence_or_default: Identity authority, official information and entry action are typed separately; the verified next action wins.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Entry Click alone is the north star.
records.consequence_or_default: Successfully resolved runner intent is the outcome; qualified Entry Click and completed entry are components.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: A generic race directory is the core product.
records.consequence_or_default: The core is trusted race identity, state and next-action resolution distributed through event pages, discovery, search, AI and partners.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: `updated_existing` means the stored record materially changed.
records.consequence_or_default: Separate processed existing, unchanged and materially changed; retain field-level/run-linked evidence.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: A successful sync proves all retained `ACTIVE` source records remain present.
records.consequence_or_default: Persist the observed source manifest; missing identities enter a reversible source-missing/recheck state and cannot remain silently current forever.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Facebook-only or club-site-only presence is intrinsically second-class.
records.consequence_or_default: Evaluate control, official designation, currency and accessibility; keep identity authority separate from entry capability.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: A discovered organiser URL can automatically populate its apparent portfolio.
records.consequence_or_default: Traverse it into candidate relationships with evidence/confidence, then verify before canonical/public use.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Repeated supporting claims are repeated organiser-event relationships.
records.consequence_or_default: Store one unique typed edge and attach multiple evidence observations.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: A registration-looking URL proves entries are open.
records.consequence_or_default: Entry state requires an observed state, checked time and appropriate destination.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Regional research can generate its own canonical IDs and state labels.
records.consequence_or_default: Resolve through a global registry and approved enums before canonicalisation.

records.section: Supersede or clarify
records.statement: Network size/evidence volume should drive verification rank.
records.consequence_or_default: Rank unique in-scope occurrences by runner value, trust gap and review cost; segment parkrun-like networks.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Quarantine `Test` and `TEST3`.
records.consequence_or_default: Remove from all public surfaces without deleting evidence.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Close anonymous access to the base `events` table.
records.consequence_or_default: Route public reads through safe projection/server APIs; test before deployment.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Replace public count semantics.
records.consequence_or_default: Deploy corrected eligibility query and honest wording together.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Exclude unknown dates from discovery.
records.consequence_or_default: Change shared eligibility layer, then audit every route and sitemap.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Prevent public duplicate occurrences.
records.consequence_or_default: Repair known escapes, redirects and canonical mapping; then strengthen ingestion gates.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Correct reminder consent and failed-send state.
records.consequence_or_default: Double opt-in, rate limit, idempotent retries, sent only after success.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Add source-observation and logical-run instrumentation before relying on rebuilt governing-body cron jobs.
records.consequence_or_default: Record first/last seen, material changes, source-missing candidates, chunk reconciliation and gate impact; do not auto-delete.

records.section: Immediate red decisions recommended for approval
records.statement: Install a deterministic research-intake validator before importing regional research or commissioning more regions.
records.consequence_or_default: Enforce global identity, enums, evidence references, unique edges, entity classes and correction reports.

records.section: Resolved current questions
records.statement: G3 requires verified official information and honest entry state, not necessarily open entries.

records.section: Resolved current questions
records.statement: Organiser-designated booking platforms qualify as official entry destinations.

records.section: Resolved current questions
records.statement: RENM-owned events may test paid-entry conversion but receive no hidden organic or trust advantage.

records.section: Resolved current questions
records.statement: Structured data/API work follows runner-facing accuracy and a buyer/partner hypothesis; it is not an SEO-content shortcut.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Does the live count include parkruns, junior parkruns, virtual races or only entry-based races?
records.consequence_or_default: Define separate named counts; do not mix materially different inventory behind “races.”

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: How should cancelled future events appear?
records.consequence_or_default: Accessible/noindex with clear cancellation when useful; excluded from discovery and counts.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Should estimated dates ever appear publicly?
records.consequence_or_default: No in the first trust model. Revisit only with explicit labelling and evidence standards.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Minimum coordinate precision for postcode-radius results?
records.consequence_or_default: Postcode centroid or better, labelled/ranked by precision; town centroid excluded from tight radii.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: What establishes an organiser as verified?
records.consequence_or_default: Official-domain evidence or repeated consistent official relationships, with manual override and audit.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: When is a series page indexable?
records.consequence_or_default: At least two supported editions plus meaningful stable content and a current/useful occurrence.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Should G2 pages be reachable from ordinary discovery or only direct/expanded results?
records.consequence_or_default: Show after G3/G4 with a clear limited-data treatment; never in close-radius results if location is imprecise.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Retention period for dormant public pages.
records.consequence_or_default: Review at 24 months; consider public retirement after four years while keeping internal history.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Should Mike remain on a shared-password admin or move to identity-based login?
records.consequence_or_default: Move to single-user identity/passkey or magic-link auth after urgent public-data fixes.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Should historic source labels ever be publicly credited?
records.consequence_or_default: No by default. Publicly show organiser/official destination, not ingestion provenance.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Can aggregate anonymised search data be kept longer than 12 months?
records.consequence_or_default: Yes only after irreversible aggregation and a documented purpose.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: How fresh must entry-state verification be by provider/event type?
records.consequence_or_default: Begin with risk-based rechecks and measure state-change frequency before fixing one SLA.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Which booking providers/organisers will support referral or completed-entry attribution?
records.consequence_or_default: Test the RENM-owned funnel first, then approach providers with evidence.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: Which organiser problem is strongest: portfolio accuracy, correction workflow, demand analytics, promotion or syndication?
records.consequence_or_default: Resolve through 15–20 structured organiser interviews before a portal build.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: What would a publisher, application or AI provider license?
records.consequence_or_default: Conduct buyer interviews/API pilot before productionising a broad public data product.

records.section: Queries needing resolution
records.statement: How should RENM-owned races be disclosed publicly?
records.consequence_or_default: Use clear organiser identity and normal sponsored labels if paid promotion is used; no special trust badge.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: Structural research-package PASS is not a RENM production promotion decision.
records.consequence_or_default: Accepted packages may enter staging/reconciliation only; G2/G3/G4 requires live-record evaluation.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: Agent self-validation is not sufficient for high-impact data packages.
records.consequence_or_default: Independently validate foreign keys, mapping targets, stable IDs, source coverage, vocabularies and immutable hashes.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: Stable identifiers survive evidence enrichment and review.
records.consequence_or_default: Unchanged logical relationship keys retain their accepted edge IDs; only genuinely changed/new edges receive different IDs.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: Mapping tables are part of referential integrity.
records.consequence_or_default: Each composite mapping key is unique and each non-empty target must resolve to the final entity/edge it claims.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: `entry` is the canonical stored destination role; availability belongs to `entry_state`.
records.consequence_or_default: Do not create parallel roles such as `live entry/booking`; retain accessibility and verification separately.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: Resolved decisions may retain residual uncertainty without becoming unresolved again.
records.consequence_or_default: Store `collision_residual_uncertainty` separately from unresolved collision decisions and schedule follow-up where useful.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: The final Kent package is accepted as a candidate-stage evidence source.
records.consequence_or_default: Use `kent-medway-candidate-evidence-reviewed-normalised-final` for future reconciliation; preserve all earlier derivatives as audit history.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: South London is structurally accepted but not equivalently entry-verified.
records.consequence_or_default: Preserve its corrected package as a candidate source and expose the remaining verification gap in planning.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: Regional pilot data is not piped directly into Lovable.
records.consequence_or_default: Build a controlled staging/reconciliation workflow first and record proposed live/public effects.

records.section: Decisions recorded at context reset — 25 July 2026
records.statement: Strategy synthesis precedes the next Lovable instruction.
records.consequence_or_default: Review runner-problem/Reddit research, competition, moat and monetisation; then amend/approve the build sequence before Phase 0.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: RENM will compete initially on trusted occurrence resolution and correct next action, not generic directory breadth.
records.consequence_or_default: Repair and measure decision quality before expanding inventory or SEO surfaces.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Authority is field- and role-specific.
records.consequence_or_default: Record who controls each material fact; do not treat any organiser, platform or reconciler as universally authoritative.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Organiser, owner, host club, race director, registration provider, timer and results operator are separate roles.
records.consequence_or_default: Contact discovery, public presentation and attribution must not collapse them into `organiser`.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Publicly contactable does not mean commercially prospectable.
records.consequence_or_default: Respect channel purpose, explicit no-sales instructions and privacy/direct-marketing requirements; keep prospectability private.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Universal `update once, publish everywhere` is not an approved product commitment.
records.consequence_or_default: Each external destination requires an authorised, supported delivery route and independently confirmed state.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The organiser-control hypothesis begins as a manual service test.
records.consequence_or_default: Do not build a portal or integration estate before organisers correct, return, authorise and show behavioural demand.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The bounded organiser hypothesis is a canonical portfolio and change-distribution layer, not booking, timing or results software.
records.consequence_or_default: Link to operational platforms and preserve their distinct authority.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Outbound traffic is not organiser value until measurement is audited and outcomes are tested.
records.consequence_or_default: Present clicks conservatively and seek aggregate completed-entry reconciliation or an authorised attribution test.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Organiser dossiers and outreach eligibility are private research.
records.consequence_or_default: Do not place contacts, restriction notes, prospect lists or raw dossiers in public projections or Lovable context.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Data structure, local completeness, reminders, APIs and difficult reconciliation are not presumed moats.
records.consequence_or_default: Describe defensibility only after demonstrated compounding participation, proprietary outcomes, switching costs or network effects.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The founder event validates RENM-controlled entry generation only.
records.consequence_or_default: It does not by itself validate independent-organiser demand, syndication or organiser software.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Apparent reminder/subscriber records that are absent from admin are a critical reconciliation incident, not evidence of valid consent or successful delivery.
records.consequence_or_default: Preserve provider/database/log evidence; do not manually recreate, contact or delete addresses until identity, consent, confirmation and delivery states are reconciled.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The 29 July admin view confirms 23 stored reminder rows across 17 events, including one controlled Mike row; all displayed reminder-sent states are blank.
records.consequence_or_default: Treat 22 apparent external records across 16 events as strong preliminary retention evidence, but not as confirmed consent, delivery or conversion. Audit before messaging.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The quick subscriber admin interface is a production mutation made before the context-reset Phase 0 boundary.
records.consequence_or_default: Preserve it for evidence, identify its commit/query/access controls and review privacy/security; do not assume its current implementation is approved permanent admin design.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Immediate acknowledgement, consent confirmation, scheduled reminder and unsubscribe/suppression are separate lifecycle events.
records.consequence_or_default: Do not collapse them into one `Reminder sent` boolean or describe acknowledgement as double-opt-in confirmation.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: A closing reminder requires an evidenced entry-closing trigger or an explicitly different event-date reminder contract.
records.consequence_or_default: Do not promise `before entries close` from the event date alone; reject or honestly handle subscriptions after the valid scheduling point.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: No scheduled reminder sender currently exists; reminder fulfilment was deliberately parked pending demand.
records.consequence_or_default: Treat blank reminder-sent states as expected current behaviour, not evidence of scheduler failure. Audit acknowledgements and stored consent, then design fulfilment separately.
records.lifecycle_note: Factually superseded when the sender endpoint and scheduled job were discovered.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The stored external reminder requests validate demand for a bounded fulfilment pilot.
records.consequence_or_default: Move the minimum safe reminder lifecycle earlier in the build sequence, but do not build broad alerts or send historic/backfilled messages without record-level eligibility review.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Mike will temporarily leave the live reminder form unchanged and monitor new requests for manual fulfilment.
records.consequence_or_default: No automated sender or form change is authorised. Each manual action must be based on verified current event/entry facts, honour the stated purpose, provide an unsubscribe route and be logged without exposing addresses in strategy records.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The 30 July code audit found a reminder sender endpoint and a migration scheduling it daily, contradicting D44 and Mike's operational understanding.
records.consequence_or_default: Treat D44 as factually superseded. Do not manually fulfil, activate, disable or modify anything until production cron, vault, HTTP, queue and send-log state establish whether automation is active and which records are due or attempted.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: With Mike's approval, production cron job 6 `send-race-reminders-daily` was paused on 30 July using `cron.alter_job(..., active := false)` after live evidence showed active scheduling but `401` endpoint responses.
records.consequence_or_default: Keep the definition inactive. Do not reactivate or repair its authentication until the reminder contract and affected-record handling are explicitly approved. Other cron jobs were verified unchanged by the containment operation.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Reminder sending must remain fail-closed at both scheduler and HTTP boundaries.
records.consequence_or_default: Job 6 remains inactive and the sender endpoint returns `503` unless `REMINDER_SENDING_ENABLED` is exactly `true`. Do not enable the flag or repair scheduler authentication without a separately approved reminder lifecycle.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The 24 stored reminder requests are retained as behavioural demand evidence, not proof of fulfilled reminders or completed entries.
records.consequence_or_default: Keep addresses private; report aggregates only. Mike will monitor new requests and any manual treatment must follow D46 until a safe lifecycle is approved.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Admin absence and empty data are distinct states.
records.consequence_or_default: Subscriber administration must show an explicit expired/unauthenticated state rather than presenting authentication failure as an empty list.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: Admin navigation will expose aggregate unseen-work indicators without emailing Mike.
records.consequence_or_default: New subscriber, race-submission and club-submission activity may create a red badge; viewing the relevant authenticated data marks it seen. Legacy subscriber rows were backfilled as seen.

records.section: Decisions recorded after organiser-contact discovery — 29 July 2026
records.statement: The maintenance containment release is the new operational baseline.
records.consequence_or_default: Production commit `c1cdc4a7e9ae4d16766125f7e56509affe6b79d4` has clean typecheck, 31 passing tests and a successful build. Resume trust work from this point; do not reopen contained reminder sending as incidental maintenance.
